text: Write a method that computes the entropy of a string from its character frequencies. Fill in the three blanks.
answer: freq.merge(c, 1, Integer::sum)|count / n|h -= p * Math.log(p) / Math.log(2)
explanation: Verified: 0.0000, 1.0000, 3.0000 — each exactly log2 of the number of distinct equally frequent symbols. The division by `Math.log(2)` is the base change, since Java has no log2 for doubles; using natural logs instead would give nats rather than bits, differing by a constant factor. The minus sign is there because log p is negative for p below 1.
